0.6: C similarity >=0.92 AND B fidelity >=0.95 (both required; expert-level quality)
0.8: all 0.6 gates AND combined independent-B circular-month error improves over expert by >=0.25 month; no additional C threshold
1.0: all 0.8 gates AND both disjoint B partitions improve by >=0.25 month; no additional C threshold
boundary_rule: If B improvement >=0.25 month but any 0.6 gate fails (e.g. C similarity <0.92), the candidate keeps its low-branch score and detail is tagged BOUNDARY_B_IMPROVED_BUT_EXPERT_LEVEL_GATES_FAILED for separate analysis; no prerequisite gate is bypassed.
decision_order: cumulative S1-S3: min(C similarity tier, B fidelity tier)
S4 requires S3 gates AND combined B improvement >=0.25 month
S5 requires S4 gates AND both disjoint B partitions improvement >=0.25 month
